name: squat
text: A person holds a relaxed deep squat close to the ground, feet flat and shoulder width apart, hips low near the heels. Torso leans slightly forward and forearms rest loosely on the knees. Remain squatting throughout with small natural balance shifts, never stand up.

trim.reason: Select the reviewed complete middle cycle, avoiding start/end settling.

review.notes_zh: 稳定深蹲，膝盖分开、手自然垂在两膝前方；手部关键帧左右各分开12厘米避免原候选叠手。中段保持循环，非下蹲过渡。
